Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Greenstone is excited about the latency profile and the streaming support; a couple of follow-ups from our side as we think about a short POC:  

- Primary ask: validate inference quality on two workflows (clinical note summarization + patient triage intents) using ~2k sample records (de-identified).
- Non-functional: need to see 95th percentile latency under realistic traffic (concurrent 30 req/s, median seq len ~350 tokens).
- Hosting sensitivity: healthcare data — we need options: (A) hosted sandbox with encrypted-at-rest and strict access controls; (B) dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) for isolation; (C) VPC/private deployment (air-gapped option) — we want a recommendation with time/cost tradeoffs.

I've attached a short spreadsheet that captures dataset slices and initial success metrics. Can you propose a recommended environment, ownership, and a two-week plan? Also include security deliverables (SOC2, data retention, redaction approach).

Available for kickoff next week (Mon/Tue mornings PST).

Team — forwarding Alyssa's note. Quick internal recap and my recommended approach below. Reply-all for alignment and I'll send to Greenstone once we agree.

Summary of external asks: 2 eval workflows (summarization, triage intents), 2k de-identified records, target p95 latency under 250ms, concurrent 30 rps. Security ask: SOC2 evidence, data retention policy, and redaction/PHI handling approach.

Recommended phased plan (3 weeks total):
1) Kickoff & data onboarding (3 business days) — collect de-id samples, confirm API keys, share SOC2 + evidence. Owners: Hannah (AM), Ben (SE), Marissa (Solutions).
2) Baseline test on Redwood hosted sandbox (days 4–7) — fast time-to-value: validate quality and latency against 200 sample records. This avoids heavy setup while we scope dedicated/VPC.
3) Targeted stress & isolation run (days 8–14) — if hosted baseline looks promising, stand up a Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) to measure p95 under concurrent load; option to switch to VPC if they require private networking.

Success criteria (draft):
- Quality: precision/recall metrics per intent >= 0.88, ROUGE-L / summary usefulness score >= 0.80 (per their eval rubric).
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for typical 350-token sequences on Dedicated; p95 < 500ms acceptable on hosted baseline.
- Cost: provide estimated compute cost for the 2-week run (token budget + reserved GPU cost).

Open questions for SE/solutions:
- Can we run their de-id pipeline client-side or should we offer our redaction tooling?
- Network setup/time for Dedicated vs VPC (estimated lead times).

Attachments to send to customer once we align: Greenstone_trial_req.xlsx, redwood-poc-mup-v1.docx (MUP = mutual action plan).

Next steps: Ben to confirm network/ops lead times; Marissa to propose minimal infra playbook and checklist. I'll propose kickoff times (Mon/Tue AM PST).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Adding operational notes / gating items:

- VPC/Private: plan for minimum 7 business days for on-prem/VPC approvals and network peering (longer if procurement requires firewall rules).
- Dedicated sandbox: can be standing in 2 business days if we allocate capacity from our dedicated pool (we have capacity in us-west). Will need a short SLA waiver for trial usage (I can handle).
- Hosted sandbox: fastest, <24h to provision tokens + sandbox workspace; will need clear redaction agreement that customer will either send de-id data or we will run our redaction hooks (privacy note: prefer they de-id before sending PHI).

Evaluation assets I recommend we prepare before kickoff:
- A 200-record pilot set with mixed severity/lengths (to validate quality quickly).
- 5 canonical prompts and expected outputs for both workflows.
- Simple stress script (k6 or similar) to reproduce 30 rps with appropriate token lengths.

I'll draft the infra checklist and the short ops runbook (who does what during the stress run). Assigning: Marissa -> ops checklist; Ben -> network & infra requirements; Hannah -> MUP + kickoff scheduling.

-marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Greenstone trial request — internal recap + recommended path

Technical notes based on the ask:

- Model options: recommend starting with an L1 open model we've validated for summarization (quantized 8-bit) for the hosted baseline. For Dedicated stress testing, run the same model on a 4-bit quantized variant to reduce latency/cost.
- KV cache + continuous batching: we'll enable prefix caching for the triage intent workflow to keep effective throughput up. That will help hit p95 targets for the Dedicated run.
- Network: Dedicated sandbox requires a single outbound TLS egress rule + peering for metrics ingestion if they want in-house logging. VPC will need CIDR ranges and firewall rules; estimate 3–5 business days to get network approved on their side. See attached: network_requirements.pdf.
- Token budgeting: estimate ~120M tokens for the 2-week run (including stress tests and debug). I'll provide a cost estimate broken down by hosted vs dedicated vs VPC options.

I can be on the kickoff call Mon 11/16 9:30am PST or Tue 11/17 10am PST.

-Ben
